questions.prompt: What is the aim of a first brain dump?

options.text: Getting ideas and questions out where you can work with them.
Collecting sources forever before writing anything.

questions.explanation: Early writing can be messy; it helps reveal what you know and what to investigate.

options.text: It gives you questions and tentative arguments to investigate.
It eliminates the need for sources.
It guarantees your first argument is correct.

questions.explanation: A starting set of questions makes research more focused.

questions.prompt: How can Wikipedia help you begin research?

options.text: By pointing you toward sources in its citations.

questions.explanation: The episode distinguishes using an article as a starting point from relying on it as your final source.
